summary.text: Purple Will Production is an immortal killer move named when Fairy Zi Wei's body shakes and turns into purple smoke.

claims.text: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s left head roars. The silhouette of Dang Hun Mountain appears and slams towards Fairy Zi Wei and Ying Wu Xie. They cannot avoid it. Fairy Zi Wei uses the killer move. Her body shakes and turns into purple smoke that carries Ying Wu Xie. They vanish on the spot. After a few breaths of time, purple smoke is produced out of nowhere several tens of li away. The purple smoke turns back into Fairy Zi Wei and Ying Wu Xie falls out from it. She had been using the method at every set interval of distance traveled. The method was originally meant to defend against the heavenly melody. She uses it to avoid Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. After using it, the two immortals survive.

Fairy Zi Wei says that after using this move there is a huge drawback. She needs to exterminate the large amount of purple will in her mind before she can use it again. As Spectral Soul Demon Venerable approaches, she uses purple will production again to stall for time.
